overall: The AG found the New Bedford School Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by entering executive session under Purpose 6 on March 11, 2019, because the discussion concerned future use and school funding, not the property deal. No further relief was required since the minutes were already released.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee improperly invoked Purpose 6 in executive session on March 11, 2019, to discuss transferring a school building to a charter school.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee’s discussion related to the future use of the property and issues of school planning and funding unrelated to the school building transaction, which are not proper topics for executive session discussion.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, with a caution that a similar future violation may be considered evidence of intent to violate.
remedy_passage: We order the Committee’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution the Committee that a determination by our office of a similar violation in the future may be considered evidence of intent to violate the Open Meeting Law.
